description: This header file defines data structures, classes, and interfaces related to scheduler feedback handling in a 5G/NR RAN context, including UL buffer status reports, CRC indications, UCI indications, SRS indications, PHR messages, and a feedback handler interface.

classes.name: harq_ack_report_list
classes.description: A list managing HARQ ACK report bits with small buffer optimization, supporting dynamic resizing and iteration.

classes.name: uci_indication
classes.description: Represents UCI (Uplink Control Information) indications for a UE, including different PDU formats.

classes.name: srs_indication
classes.description: Represents SRS (Sounding Reference Signal) indications for a cell, including multiple PDUs.

classes.name: scheduler_feedback_handler
classes.description: Abstract interface for handling various scheduler feedback messages such as BSR, CRC, UCI, SRS, PHR, and MAC CEs.

methods.name: handle_ul_bsr_indication
methods.description: Handles UL Buffer Status Report indications.

methods.name: handle_dl_mac_ce_indication
methods.description: Handles DL MAC Control Element indications.
